## Summary

Sofija Vytautaitė (1371-1453), Vytautas's only child in the record; named among the hostages demanded at Lyck (19 Jan 1390), she left Marienburg via Danzig and Pskov in autumn 1390 and married Vasily I of Moscow on 9 Jan 1391.

## Record vs saga

- **[Record]:** Hostage (Posilge via Grala; escorted by Ivan Olshanski); married 9 Jan 1391 (Trinity Chronicle); regent for Vasily II from 1425. The only recorded child of Vytautas.
- **[Saga invention]:** Her letters in Book II ch. 8; the bead on Vytautas's tomb (Book V).
